title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ الددو يشارك في ملتقى دولي بتركيا..
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Takes Part in an International Forum in Turkey…
body_ar:
ألقى سماحة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء بموريتانيا مساء اليوم الجمعة 07 أكتوبر 2016م كلمة دعا في بدايتها إلى مؤازرة الإخوة المرابطين في المسجد الأقصى و فلسطين عموما، محذرا من التقاعس عن نصرتهم مؤكدا على أحقية المسلمين في تلك الأرض المباركة و أن الله قد امتحنهم بالصهاينة و أن النصر قاب قوسين أو أدنى و لا يناله إلا المجاهدون الصابرون المحتسبون،

مشددا على أهمية دور العلماء و محوريته في توعية الأمة و الوقوف ضد حملات التطبيع.

كان ذلك في الجلسة الافتتاحية للدورة الثامنة من ملتقى الرواد في العالم الإسلامي المنعقد هذا العام تحت شعار "الأقصى في خطر" بمدينة اسطنبول التركية، و المنظم من طرف الائتلاف العالمي لنصرة القدس والأقصى، و قد افتتح هذا الملتقى بعرض فيلم تعريفي، و رسالة إلى فضيلة الشيخ رائد صلاح رئيس الحركة الاسلامية داخل الخط الأخضر و المعتقل في السجون الصهيونية، و ذلك في إطار تضامن الملتقى هذا العام مع الشيخ صلاح و الأسرى الفلسطينيين.

و قد حضر الملتقى أكثر من 500 مشارك يمثلون أكثر من 30 دولة عربية و إسلامية، جاؤوا لبحث و مناقشة و تقديم الأفكار التي من شأنها الوقوف ضد حملات الاستيطان في المدينة المقدسة "القدس الشريف"، و لدعم المرابطين فيها وإيجاد آليات لتنسيق الجهود في مختلف المجالات التي يمكنها مواجهة خطط التقسيم الزماني والمكاني للمسجد الأقصى المبارك. هذا و يستمر الملتقى لمدة يومين 07 و 08 أكتوبر 2016م.

وقد تأسس الائتلاف العالمي لنصرة القدس والأقصى عام 2011م بمشاركة 350 ناشطاً من مختلف العالم الاسلامي، وتبنى الائتلاف بالتعاون مع شركائه عدداً من البرامج والفعاليات من بينها "اليوم العالمي للتضامن مع الشعب الفلسطيني" و"المسيرة العالمية للقدس".
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars in Mauritania, delivered an address on the evening of Friday 7 October 2016, in which he began by calling for support for the brothers standing guard (al-murābiṭūn) at the Aqsa Mosque and in Palestine generally, warning against holding back from coming to their aid; affirming the Muslims' rightful claim to that blessed land, that God has tested them by means of the Zionists, and that victory is two bow-lengths away or nearer, and that none will attain it but those who struggle in God's cause, who are patient and who seek God's reward.

He stressed the importance of the scholars' role and its centrality in raising the community's awareness and in standing against the campaigns for normalisation.

This was at the opening session of the eighth round of the Forum of the Pioneers in the Islamic World, held this year under the banner 'Al-Aqsa in Danger' in the Turkish city of Istanbul, and organised by the Global Coalition for the Support of Jerusalem and al-Aqsa. The forum opened with the screening of an introductory film and a message to Sheikh Raed Salah, head of the Islamic Movement inside the Green Line, who is held in Zionist prisons — this within the framework of the forum's solidarity this year with Sheikh Salah and with the Palestinian prisoners.

More than 500 participants attended the forum, representing more than 30 Arab and Islamic countries. They came to examine, to debate and to put forward ideas apt to stand against the settlement campaigns in the holy city, 'al-Quds al-Sharif'; to support those standing guard in it; and to find mechanisms for coordinating efforts in the various fields capable of confronting the plans for the temporal and spatial division of the blessed Aqsa Mosque. The forum runs for two days, 7 and 8 October 2016.

The Global Coalition for the Support of Jerusalem and al-Aqsa was founded in 2011 with the participation of 350 activists from across the Islamic world. In cooperation with its partners the coalition has adopted a number of programmes and events, among them the 'International Day of Solidarity with the Palestinian People' and the 'Global March to Jerusalem'.

flags.arabic: لا يناله إلا المجاهدون الصابرون المحتسبون
flags.context: the Sheikh's opening call regarding al-Aqsa and Palestine
options: none will attain it but those who struggle in God's cause, who are patient and who seek God's reward
it is attained only by the mujahidin who endure and who count their effort with God
only those who strive, persevere and act for God's sake will reach it
flags.note: EDITORIALLY SENSITIVE. مجاهدون rendered as 'those who struggle in God's cause' rather than 'mujahidin' or 'fighters': the Arabic term is broad and the address does not specify armed action, so a narrower English word would strengthen the statement beyond what the Arabic says. Equally, an over-abstract rendering would soften it. Published in English, in a passage about Palestine, the sentence carries legal and reputational exposure in several jurisdictions whichever rendering is chosen. Referred up.

options: who count their effort to their account with God
who act in expectation of reward from God alone
flags.note: iḥtisāb is on the style guide's list of glossary additions pending (section 13), so the rendering is flagged rather than fixed. See also record 986, where the same root raises the question directly.

flags.arabic: و رسالة إلى فضيلة الشيخ رائد صلاح ... و المعتقل في السجون الصهيونية
options: a message to Sheikh Raed Salah, head of the Islamic Movement inside the Green Line, who is held in Zionist prisons
a message to Sheikh Raed Salah ... who is detained in Israeli prisons
flags.note: EDITORIALLY SENSITIVE and concerns a living, named individual. 'الصهيونية' has been translated as the Arabic has it rather than normalised to 'Israeli', since normalising it would alter the register of the source; but the English carries a characterisation of a state's prisons and of a named person's detention. The site's report, not the Sheikh's words. Publication decision belongs to Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office.

options: efforts to normalise relations with Israel
flags.note: التطبيع in this context is normalisation of relations with Israel. The Arabic leaves the object unstated and the English does the same rather than supplying it; a reader outside the region may not follow, so the display may need a gloss — but that is an editorial decision, not a translator's.

translator_notes: A news report written by the site, reporting the Sheikh's address indirectly.
'قاب قوسين أو أدنى' is a Qur'anic idiom (Sūrat al-Najm 53:9) used here proverbially for imminence; rendered literally, since the allusion is part of the register.
المرابطون are those posted in ribāṭ, holding a frontier position; rendered 'standing guard' rather than transliterated. The word carries no implication of combat by itself.
The trailing '..' in the title is in the source and has been kept.
The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date, not the date of composition.
